description:
How often aircraft pass low over a suburb: recorded passes per week, the busiest hour of the day and how well we could hear the place. From nine days of our own aircraft recording, September 2026. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: About 7,100 suburbs and localities in every state and territory where aircraft were recorded; 9 days, 8 to 24 September 2026. Current to 2026-09-24. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/flight-paths`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: passes_per_week, busiest_hour, busiest_hour_passes_per_day, coverage_class. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_environment_flight_paths
title: Suburb · Aircraft overflights
